ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only a describing word

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

3. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

4. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. went

6. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

11. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. run

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops
